note: Photo registration of MCEE facility outlines (osm-ground.json facilities stay as fetched; lib/groundRegistration.mjs applies these in network/surfaces.mjs loadGroundFeatures). move: original vertex indices of ring 0, dE/dN metres (EPSG:5186). Measured on the NGII 2025 sheet (34702020) as the median position of the strongest red-minus-green step within +-1.5 m of each segment (the red track against the green apron; luminance cannot see that boundary), MAD <= 0.10 m; vertices between measured segments interpolated; a vertex moves when its offset exceeds 0.25 m. Re-measured in the follow-up with the sheet pixel centres taken as the world file gives them (the first measurement sampled the photo half a pixel north-west, +0.125 m E / -0.125 m N). Estimated (추정).
